motivation: New preferred-Top5 proxy after the original all-observed holdout and reported Kaggle result; this is not an untouched original holdout or a claim about the hidden evaluator.
clock: Original naive source wall-clock coordinates; no inferred timezone conversion
candidate_policy: One common labelled-programme pool from each target window's prepared schedule
cohort_policy: Template users with at least one observable eligible held-out programme; identical IDs and order for every method within a block, including cold users

targets.primary: At most five unique eligible held-out programmes ranked by total accepted overlap seconds descending, then programme ID ascending
targets.secondary: At most five unique eligible held-out programmes ranked by total accepted watch counts descending, then programme ID ascending
targets.diagnostic: All unique eligible observed held-out programmes
targets.empty_targets: AP=0 in metric; no-eligible-target users excluded once before all method comparisons

selection: Highest early-development primary Top5-seconds MAP@5 among eligible methods; exact ties use the fixed methods array order; personal-history methods are diagnostics only
confirmation_policy: After selection is written, assess only the selected method and the three original baselines; never retune or reselect using confirmation
graph: Original training-only co-view graph with log1p(seconds) row-normalized contributions; improved variants change restart seeds only

recency_variant.name: improved_ppr_0.15_seconds_raw_recency28d
recency_variant.event_timestamp: maximum accepted clipped-overlap right endpoint of each canonical airing, bounded by the training cutoff
recency_variant.aggregation: Sum accepted event seconds times 2**(-age_days/28) per user and item; multiply aggregate seconds by recent_seconds/seconds before power1.0

pre_metric_revision.reason: Parent finalized lower diffusion and sqrt/raw seeds based on diagnosed log compression before running any v2 metrics; no later grid expansion permitted.
